mapper.select: SELECT goal_id, user_id, name, target_amount, current_amount, start_date, due_date, is_main, status, created_at, updated_at FROM goals WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_main DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT goal_id, user_id, name, target_amount, current_amount, start_date, due_date, is_main, status, created_at, updated_at FROM goals WHERE goal_id = #{goalId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goals (user_id, name, target_amount, start_date, due_date, is_main) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{targetAmount}, #{startDate}, #{dueDate}, #{isMain})
mapper.update: UPDATE goals SET name = #{name}, target_amount = #{targetAmount}, start_date = #{startDate}, due_date = #{dueDate}, is_main = #{isMain} WHERE goal_id = #{goalId}
UPDATE goals SET is_main = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_main = 1
